items.message: `getattr` fallback silently accepts a client that exposes `base_url` as a non-string attribute.
`unknown` is computed unconditionally but then filtered only when `routes` is set; without routes it reports every unknown endpoint regardless of what this repo actually routes.
Gemini receives `base_url=gemini_endpoint or ""`, so when no region is set the settings carry an empty string while `endpoint` is `None`.
